question: Does replacing the network-selection transitive-triad term with native GWESP(69) change forecast quality and excessive predicted clustering under comparable estimation and forecast budgets?
historical_import: Replay exact compatible optimization checkpoints in attempt order; recompute acceptance under the new policy, never import a historical acceptance or forecast. Any model with a matching bound history is eligible, independent of role.
primary: Mean of four annual candidate-minus-reference PR-AUC differences. Each annual point uses probabilities averaged over all 5000 endpoints BEFORE PRROC scoring.
uncertainty: Report five independent 1000-endpoint batch contrasts separately. Approximate Monte Carlo uncertainty of the pooled point by a five-block delete-one-batch jackknife, with blocks pairing the predeclared independent model/year batch indices. Preserve whole simulated networks. Report the four-year jackknife SE and a descriptive t(4) interval; it is not fitting or historical generalization uncertainty and is fragile for nonsmooth ranking metrics/ties.
failure: Retain failed or interrupted cells and exact checkpoints. No changed seeds, extra candidates, partial four-year score, silent restart or reserved-year access.
interpretation: A development-stage comparison motivated partly by an already observed 2007 discrepancy, not a preregistered historical out-of-sample confirmation, causal test, free-riding test, evolutionary result, or measurement of fit-seed variability.
